user.title: Aerohive / Extreme Networks device
user.description: Connect to an access point or branch router over SSH. Provide a password, an SSH private key path, or both.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device.
data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to a private key file readable by Home Assistant, e.g. /config/.ssh/aerohive.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Keep this at 60 or higher for a BR100.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check host, port and that SSH is enabled on the device.
error.invalid_key: The SSH key file could not be read.
error.password_or_key: Enter a password or an SSH key path.

data.raw_sensors: Create sensors for every raw field

data_description.tracked_clients: Create a device tracker and detail sensors (signal, SNR, rates, SSID) only for these client MAC addresses (pick from connected clients or type a MAC).
data_description.detailed_stats: Throughput and counters for Ethernet ports and SSID sub-interfaces, plus CPU and memory. Adds a few CLI commands per poll; turn off for a slow BR100.
data_description.raw_sensors: One sensor (disabled by default) for every other field the CLI reports, so you can enable anything you need.

error.invalid_mac: One of the entries is not a valid MAC address.

run_show_command.name: Run show command
run_show_command.description: Run a read-only 'show' command on the device and return the raw output (for capturing parser samples).

command.name: Command
command.description: A command starting with 'show', e.g. 'show station'.

redact.name: Redact secrets
redact.description: Mask key/password arguments in the output.

set_ssid_password.name: Set SSID password
set_ssid_password.description: Change the WPA2-PSK key of an SSID and save the configuration.

password.name: Password
password.description: New key, 8-63 printable ASCII characters (no double quotes).

security_object.name: Security object
security_object.description: Security-object name. Looked up in the running config if omitted (falls back to the SSID name).

disconnect_client.name: Disconnect client
disconnect_client.description: De-authenticate a wireless client by MAC address.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: Client MAC address in any common format.
